daily.title: Major AI company Anthropic signs deal to use $32b Queensland data centre
daily.summary: A $32 billion data centre proposed for a site west of Brisbane will be used by AI giant Anthropic.

daily.title: Unpacking the 12 days that threw Ed Sheeran's tour into chaos
daily.summary: The withdrawal of a touring band and support acts for Ed Sheeran's Loops tour is a saga involving the removal of Macklemore from shows over pro-Palestinian comments. Here's how it's played out thus far.

daily.title: Commissioner says system 'failing' amid reports kids living alone in squalor
daily.summary: The government admits delays in response to reports more than a dozen children had been living unsupervised in squalid conditions in South Hedland.

daily.title: Breaking: Emergency warning for fire at Blackmore, west of Berry Springs
daily.summary: Bushfires Northern Territory have issued an emergency warning for a fire at Stockwell Road in Blackmore, west of Berry Springs.

daily.title: Bazzana whacks two home runs in vital MLB win for Guardians
daily.summary: Australian Travis Bazzana has continued his impressive rookie season with two home runs, helping Cleveland secure a crucial 7-6 win over the Chicago White Sox in its battle for a Major League Baseball play-off berth.

daily.title: Two NSW footballers behind bars after being found guilty of rape
daily.summary: After deliberating for one day, a jury has found  two country New South Wales footballers guilty of raping a woman at Scone in 2023.

daily.title: Family visas for foreign students targeted in migration crackdown
daily.summary: International students would effectively be banned from bringing family members to Australia under a long-awaited overhaul of the immigration system.

daily.title: Police investigate sand dunes death of Mackay mother
daily.summary: Police are trying to fill in the last four days of Payge Leembruggen's life.

daily.title: Where have all the British backpackers gone?
daily.summary: British backpackers are coming to Australia in record numbers, but the traditional working holiday has changed. As the government grapples with migration, the 88-day rule has become part of a bigger debate about what Australia wants from its young British visitors.

daily.title: Former spy chief says media failed to report widely on antisemitism
daily.summary: Former spy boss Dennis Richardson has criticised the media's handling of "blatant antisemitism" in Australia after the October 7 Hamas attacks and has called for an "open discussion" about extremist Islamists without targeting the broader Australian Muslim community.

daily.title: ACT Greens end key working relationship with government
daily.summary: The Greens have blown up their relationship with the ACT government, leaving the minority Labor government in a perilous position.

daily.title: NRLW greats Elliot, Baxter, announce retirement at end of finals
daily.summary: The NRLW will farewell two of its most influential figures with Sydney Roosters pair Millie Elliott and Corban Baxter announcing their retirements.

daily.title: NT government moves 150 Darwin homeless shelter residents out of town
daily.summary: Up to 150 residents at a Darwin homeless shelter will be relocated 100 kilometres south to Batchelor after the site's owner and the Northern Territory and federal governments could not agree on a funding arrangement.

daily.title: At least three dead in LA news helicopter crash near fatal bus accident
daily.summary: The NBCLA media outlet has confirmed the helicopter was one of its news choppers which had been flying in the area while reporting on the bus crash.

daily.title: Key SA wave buoy to be redeployed a third time after lightning damage
daily.summary: The Bureau of Meteorology wave buoy has only been operational for about 10 months in two years, but replacement parts have been secured following its most outage and it's expected to be transmitting data again this week.

daily.title: Federal funding delays put Alice Springs youth centre rebuild in jeopardy
daily.summary: The redevelopment of a youth centre providing crucial support to disadvantaged Aboriginal children in Alice Springs is in jeopardy due to federal funding delays.

daily.title: ACT government minister censured over library opening hours
daily.summary: An emotional Tara Cheyne defended her track record as she was censured in the ACT Legislative Assembly over reduced library hours, a move criticised by independent Leanne Castley, who said her former party intended to "censure, smear and whinge their way to the 2028 election".

daily.title: Kenilworth Dairies offers lifeline to Queensland dairy farm facing closure
daily.summary: A Queensland family that feared 80 years of dairying would end after a contract was not renewed has been offered a last-minute lifeline.

daily.title: Woman's 'courageous' attempt to fight off attacker praised by ACT judge
daily.summary: A man has been sentenced to five years in jail for sexually assaulting a woman in an underground car park in Canberra's north.

daily.title: Credlin demands PM explain wedding invite to sacked staffer Rhys Muldoon
daily.summary: Offensive social media posts from former Play School star Rhys Muldoon have resurfaced after reports he had been hired by Labor senator Richard Dowling.

daily.title: Melbourne council rejects bid to build new church in green wedge
daily.summary: A growing religious community in the city's south-east will have to keep looking for a new spiritual home, after councillors rejected a bid to build a church on protected green wedge land.

daily.title: Houthi drone shot down near Mecca, Saudi-led coalition says
daily.summary: Saudi authorities say a drone attack, which they claim was launched by Yemen's Houthi rebels, was intercepted before it could reach the holy city of Mecca.

daily.title: Third appeal lodged against Australian-record $150m native title payout
daily.summary: Fortescue is the third group to appeal against a record Federal Court award of $150.3 million to traditional owners. Both the Yindjibarndi people and the WA government have lodged filings of their own.

daily.title: Website crashes due to demand for Spirit of Tasmania bookings
daily.summary: High demand for tickets on the brand-new Spirit of Tasmania ferries has resulted in 150,000 visits to its booking system, crashing the website.

daily.title: Release of Snowtown serial killer 'very distressing' for victims
daily.summary: The decision to approve the release of Snowtown serial killer James Vlassakis on parole has come "as a shock" even though it was not unexpected, SA victims' rights commissioner says.

developing.title: Live: Hadley back in the witness box for a third day, as Jones trial resumes
developing.summary: Ray Hadley returns for a third day to Alan Jones's indecent assault and sexual touching trial, which has been examining the pair's "tumultuous" relationship.

developing.title: Live: ASX to open higher after sea of green on Wall Street
developing.summary: The ASX is set to open higher after gains on Wall Street. The price of oil is above $US95/barrel as the bond market steadies. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

developing.title: Live: Opposition leader says teachers running 'political agendas' in schools
developing.summary: Angus Taylor would not say whether he agreed with comments from Nationals leader Matt Canavan that there needed to be more male teachers in classrooms. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Hawks on verge of stunning upset as Dockers need a miracle
developing.summary: Fremantle's finals campaign starts with a stern test in the west, taking on Hawthorn in the first qualifying final at Perth Stadium. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: ASX recovers from three-month low, surging oil prices drag Wall Street lower
developing.summary: The Australian share market has risen slightly, though is still trading near its lowest level since mid-June. Wall Street extended its sell-off as oil prices spiked on further signs of disruption in Saudi Arabian crude supplies. Follow live.

developing.title: Live: Burke to unveil Labor's revamped migration policy tomorrow after delay
developing.summary: Tony Burke will announce Labor's highly anticipated migration overhaul tomorrow, a month after he was forced to postpone a planned address. Follow live.
